items.briefing:
Australians are being warned about active scams impersonating myGov and fake invoice emails, flagged by security firm Proofpoint. These phishing attempts are designed to steal personal or financial information, and can look convincing. Separately, a new Sydney-based startup called Bugtri has launched to help organisations filter out low-quality, AI-generated vulnerability reports — a growing problem as automated tools flood security teams with noise.

A recent study also found that only 5% of staff use generative AI tools effectively, highlighting the importance of proper training before relying on AI at work. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected myGov or invoice email, don't click any links — go directly to the official website instead.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost $2.18B to scams in 2025 via fake myGov and invoice fraud.
